title: Every building in Los Angeles County
excerpt: Every building standing in Los Angeles County today, one box per structure, appearing in the year it was built. The surviving county, 1880 to now.
content_html:
Every building
in LA County

One box per building standing today, appearing in the year it was built. What was torn down along the way isn't here, so this is the surviving county, not the county as it was.
